_: Palettes with verified contrast. 4-6 tokens per theme - more competes for attention, fewer is not enough. Check: node scripts/theme.mjs --check
_fonts: display+body pairs. Not Inter: it sits in the list of tells for generated work (web-artifacts-builder), and that is fair - it has been used for everything.

swiss.about: Light minimalism, one red accent, dense grid. Default for decks and reports.

editorial.about: Paper and serious text: serif in headings, grotesque in the body. For long reads and case studies.

product.about: Product interface: neutral grey scale, one blue for actions and states.

violet.about: Corporate violet on white. For material that has to wear an organisation's identity rather than a decorative palette — substitute your own hex values.

stone.about: Muted stone and conifer. Calm, without a single bright spot - for long documents.

night.about: Dark but not neon: cold graphite, one cold accent. For a demo in a dark room.
